_comment: Canonical manifest of repo files that are DEPLOYED to the operator Mac's
~/.config/ourliberty/ and executed from there (Claude Code hooks, the
capture gesture). Sole source of truth for scripts/sync_desktop_config.py;
Only files listed here are ever written. ~/.config/ourliberty also holds
origin-staleness-banner.py, ol-session.sh) and the ingest-token secret,
which have no repo source and MUST NOT be touched by the sync.
Destination filename is the basename of the source path.
